description: This file contains functions for handling and manipulating OpenAPI specifications, including filtering, renaming, merging, and comparing definitions and parameters, specifically for Kubernetes API schemas.

methods.name: usedDefinitionForSpec
methods.description: Returns a map of all used definitions in the provided Swagger spec.

methods.name: FilterSpecByPaths
methods.description: Removes unnecessary paths and definitions from the Swagger spec based on specified path prefixes.

methods.name: FilterSpecByPathsWithoutSideEffects
methods.description: Removes paths and associated definitions without mutating the input, returning a filtered Swagger spec.

methods.name: renameDefinitions
methods.description: Renames definition references in the Swagger spec without mutating the input.

methods.name: renameParameters
methods.description: Renames parameter references in the Swagger spec without mutating the input.

methods.name: MergeSpecsIgnorePathConflictRenamingDefinitionsAndParameters
methods.description: Merges two Swagger specs, renaming conflicting definitions and parameters, ignoring path conflicts.

methods.name: MergeSpecsIgnorePathConflictDeprecated
methods.description: Merges Swagger specs, ignoring path conflicts, with optional renaming of definitions and parameters.

methods.name: MergeSpecsFailOnDefinitionConflict
methods.description: Merges Swagger specs and fails if there are conflicting definitions or parameters.

methods.name: MergeSpecs
methods.description: Merges two Swagger specs, resolving conflicts with optional renaming, and fails on duplicate paths.
